extracted.intended_audience: Heads of executive departments and establishments (executive branch departments/agencies)
extracted.subtask_description: Transmittal memorandum rescinding the requirement to submit an Annual Management Report under OMB Circular No. A-44 (Revised), and clarifying which parts of the Circular remain in effect and that new policy guidance will be issued. Applies to all executive departments and establishments and is effective immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for Annual Management Report (rescinded)
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement for the submission of an Annual Management Report, as prescribed by the Office of Management and Budget Circular No. A-44, Revised, dated May 24, 1972, is rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'The requirement for the submission of an Annual Management Report, as prescribed by the Office of Management and Budget Circular No. A-44, Revised, dated May 24, 1972, is rescinded.' Effective immediately and 'applies to all departments and agencies.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Remaining policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program
rubrics_metrics.description: The remaining portions of the Circular dealing with policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program remain in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'The remaining portions of the Circular dealing with policy aspects of the Management Improvement Program remain in effect. The program is currently undergoing review and new policy guidelines will be forthcoming.' This indicates that, while the Annual Management Report requirement is rescinded, other policy guidance from A-44 continues to govern until further updated.
